speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the specific behaviors your wife observed that led her to bring you in? How long has this agitation and bizarre behavior been going on?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: He is experiencing persecutory delusions and delusions of control, accompanied by social withdrawal and functional decline over the last three months, which strongly suggests a psychotic disorder. To differentiate between Schizophrenia and other etiologies, I need to rule out substance use or medical causes. Have you noticed any changes in his sleep patterns, appetite, or personal hygiene during this period, and has he used any illicit substances or alcohol recently?
